answer: Securing an autonomous multi-agent economy against Sybil attacks requires cryptoeconomic staking where every AI node must lock capital before validating transactions. Imagine deploying agents across a digital ocean of data, where each must embark on a verified computational voyage to earn network trust. Just as a physical grove requires discrete roots to draw soil nutrients rather than an infinite phantom canopy, this staked economic weight imposes a linear financial cost on attackers, making the creation of millions of fake identities economically irrational.
